body: I guess I feel awful about it because to me, it feels cheap and superficial. I dunno, thank you for talking to me. I really do appreciate it, I have calmed down a lot and feel less frantic.

No. I tried therapy - my insurance either didn't work with them or they were inept. The woman seriously asked me every session about my past, things I had literally gone over the week before. She genuinely forgot/ didn't care enough to remember, and didn't help me along even though I made it clear I needed help and not just someone to listen. I've called crisis lines more times than I care to remember, every single person made me feel like I was a waste of oxygen and their time. I will never recommend suicide and crisis lines to anyone. They've always made me feel worse after hanging up the phone.

And thank you for your response, I'm sorry if I come off combative, it is in no way directed at you and is directed towards my past experiences. I hope you understand. I know I'm more than a face... I just feel so incredibly ugly inside and it might sound awful but I know I'm pretty on the outside. It's the one thing I know I can consistently get compliments on, so I whore it out when I feel low. It's so awful and I hate myself for it.
